questions.question: When the people of Israel met Solomon's son Rehoboam to make him king, what did they ask him to do?
When King Rehoboam asked the elders who had served his father Solomon for advice, what did they tell him?

answers.text: Serve the people and speak kindly
Wait until the people calm down

questions.question: When the people of Israel came back to King Rehoboam for his answer, how did he speak to them?

answers.text: Harshly as the young men advised
Warmly with a promise of rest

questions.question: When King Rehoboam gathered 180,000 warriors to fight Israel, what did the LORD tell them through Shemaiah?

answers.text: Do not fight your brothers and go home
Go up and win the kingdom back
Wait three days and then attack
